description: Land Aquisition - Thoddaveli, Mannar Town  D/S Division, Mannar District, Gaudarimunai, Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi District. Weliweriya East, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains orders for taking possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or detailed portfolio responsibilities of the minister mentioned. The ministerial signature is incidental to the land acquisition authority rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
